extracted.name: Christmas Rocks Cookies
extracted.description: I didn’t use the wine, mostly because I didn’t have any. So I “borrowed” some whiskey from my neighbor, with the promise of some cookies. Even trade. Lol
instruction_lines: Cut up fruit into small pieces. Mix it all together with pecans. Dredge in 1/2 cup of flour, set aside.
Mix all together and chill overnight.
Drop by spoonfuls onto parchment paper lined baking sheet.
